<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/templates.ts -->
<!--
  Template gallery: a heading, outline filter pills, a grid of template cards and a full-width browse-all
  button.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Template, Filter } from "./template-grid.types";

export type TemplateGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  templates: Template[];
  filters: Filter[];
  filtersLabel: string;
  browse: string;
  browseHref?: string;
  viewsLabel: string;
  likesLabel: string;
  cols?: "1-3" | "1-4";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import IconBadge from "../primitives/iconbadge/icon-badge.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  templates,
  filters,
  filtersLabel,
  browse,
  browseHref = "#/",
  viewsLabel,
  likesLabel,
  cols = "1-4",
  tone = "default",
  density = "compact",
} = defineProps<TemplateGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" title="" :tone="tone" :density="density" measure="fill" class="py-0">
    <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
      <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="h-8 w-full flex-wrap">
        <Title :as="2" size="2xl" weight="semibold" class="leading-9" :id="(id + '-title')">
          {{ title }}
        </Title>
        <Group
          gap="4"
          align="center"
          class="flex-wrap"
          role="group"
          :aria-label="filtersLabel"
          data-testid="template-filters"
        >
          <Button
            v-for="f in filters"
            :key="f.id"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            type="button"
            class="gap-2"
            data-testid="template-filter"
          >
            <LucideIcon v-if="f.icon" :name="f.icon" :size="16" />
            {{ f.title }}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Group>
      <Grid :cols="cols" class="w-full gap-6" data-testid="template-grid">
        <Box v-for="t in templates" :key="t.id"
          :class="cn(
            'flex flex-col gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border',
            defaults.templates.card
          )"
          data-testid="template-card"
        >
          <Box :class="cn('shrink-0 overflow-hidden', defaults.templates.image)">
            <MediaFrame :alt="t.title" ratio="16/9" :class="cn('size-full', defaults.media.rounded)" />
          </Box>
          <Group gap="4" align="center" :class="cn('w-full', defaults.templates.footer)" data-testid="template-footer">
            <IconBadge size="sm" class="overflow-hidden" data-testid="template-avatar">
              <LucideIcon name="layout-template" :size="16" />
            </IconBadge>
            <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="semibold" class="truncate leading-6">
                {{ t.title }}
              </Title>
              <Group gap="4" align="center" class="h-4 text-muted-foreground">
                <Group gap="2" align="center" :aria-label="viewsLabel">
                  <LucideIcon name="eye" :size="16" />
                  <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
                    {{ t.views }}
                  </Text>
                </Group>
                <Group gap="2" align="center" :aria-label="likesLabel">
                  <LucideIcon name="heart" :size="16" />
                  <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
                    {{ t.likes }}
                  </Text>
                </Group>
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        </Box>
      </Grid>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" :href="browseHref" class="w-full" data-testid="template-browse">
        {{ browse }}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
